sentences.en: He has financially ruined not only himself but his family.
sentences.zh: 他不仅自己在经济上破产了，还拖累了整个家庭。

sentences.en: How can I be better financially prepared in the future?
sentences.zh: 我怎样才能在未来更好地从经济上做好准备？

sentences.en: We were financially troubled, in short, we were bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 我们陷入了严重的财务困境，简单地说就是破产了。
